description: A29/B3: two devices tick the same habit-day offline with different client log ids. The server keeps the first row; the second mutation is an identical desired state, accepted without a new version, and its ack carries the canonical entity_id, which differs from the mutation's. The client remaps its local row and outbox rows in one transaction.
rules: entity_id differs from the mutation's entity_id
entity_id equals the first device's log id
